tools.description: Convert a document (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, PDF) or a raster image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF) into Markdown. Give a url the server fetches, or the file's bytes base64-encoded in data. A filename hint (e.g. report.csv) is required for CSV. An HTML page converts to its title and body text, not to structured Markdown (no links or tables). Returns the Markdown inline; pass embed: false to store it and receive an artifact URL instead. Pass ocr: true to OCR scanned PDF pages via the configured backend; raster images are always OCR'd.

embed.description: true: Markdown returned inline (default); false: stored artifact, URL returned

filename.description: format hint like report.docx; required for CSV

ocr.description: true: OCR scanned PDF pages via the configured backend; false (default): scanned pages answer needs_ocr. Retry busy and transport errors with backoff (max 3 attempts); never retry document errors

url.description: http(s) URL of the document to fetch and convert

tools.name: convert_document

tools.description: Edit prior images by their LunaRoute image id. Pass the id returned by generate_image (or a prior edit_image) in image_ids — not image bytes or URLs.

embed.description: Also return the edited image bytes inline. Large images are returned by URL only.

guidance.description: Prompt adherence. Defaults to the model's default; must be in the model's range.

image_ids.description: Prior LunaRoute image ids (img_…) to edit, in order. 1..model max_reference_images.

model.description: Which image model to edit with. flux2-klein: accepts up to 4 reference images, default size 1024x1024, up to 2048x2048, steps 1-50 (default 4), guidance 0-10 (default 1), formats png/jpeg/webp, prompt up to 4000 chars, no negative_prompt support; qwen-image-2.1: accepts up to 4 reference images, default size 1024x1024, up to 1280x1280, steps 1-50 (default 40), guidance 0-10 (default 4), formats png/jpeg/webp, prompt up to 4000 chars, supports negative_prompt; qwen-image-edit-2511: accepts up to 4 reference images, default size 1024x1024, up to 2048x2048, steps 1-50 (default 40), guidance 0-10 (default 1), formats png/jpeg/webp, prompt up to 4000 chars, supports negative_prompt

negative_prompt.description: What to avoid. Only for models listed above as supporting it.

output_format.description: One of the model's formats listed above.

prompt.description: How to edit. For multi-image models the image 1 / image 2 referencing convention is stated under `model`.

seed.description: Seed for a reproducible edit. Omit for a random one.

size.description: WIDTHxHEIGHT, e.g. 1024x1024. Defaults to the model's default size.

steps.description: Denoising steps. Defaults to the model's default; must be in the model's range.

tools.name: edit_image

tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt. Returns the image's id and a time-limited URL; pass embed: true to also receive the bytes inline (dropped, with a note, when they exceed the server's embed limit).

embed.description: Also return the image bytes inline. Large images are returned by URL only.

guidance.description: Prompt adherence. Defaults to the model's default; must be in the model's range.

model.description: Which image model to generate with. flux2-klein: default size 1024x1024, up to 2048x2048, steps 1-50 (default 4), guidance 0-10 (default 1), formats png/jpeg/webp, prompt up to 4000 chars, no negative_prompt support; qwen-image-2.1: default size 1024x1024, up to 1280x1280, steps 1-50 (default 40), guidance 0-10 (default 4), formats png/jpeg/webp, prompt up to 4000 chars, supports negative_prompt; qwen-image-2512: default size 1024x1024, up to 2048x2048, steps 1-50 (default 20), guidance 1-10 (default 4), formats png/jpeg/webp, prompt up to 4000 chars, supports negative_prompt

negative_prompt.description: What to avoid. Only for models listed above as supporting it.

output_format.description: One of the model's formats listed above.

prompt.description: What to generate. Per-model length limits are listed under `model`.

seed.description: Seed for a reproducible generation. Omit for a random one.

size.description: WIDTHxHEIGHT, e.g. 1024x1024. Defaults to the model's default size.

steps.description: Denoising steps. Defaults to the model's default; must be in the model's range.

tools.name: generate_image

tools.description: Upload an image you already have (a local file's bytes, or an http(s) URL) to get a LunaRoute image id. Returns the id, a time-limited URL, and dimensions. Pass that id to edit_image's image_ids.

data.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (png, jpeg, or webp). Exactly one of data or url.

mime_type.description: Declared codec of data. Optional; when omitted the codec is sniffed from the bytes.

url.description: http(s) URL of the image to fetch server-side. Exactly one of data or url.

tools.name: upload_image

tools.description: Search the web through the configured provider set. Returns a normalized schema — {query, provider, results: [{title, url, snippet, published_date, score}]} — identical across providers; an empty successful search returns results: [].

count.description: Optional result count; clamped to the provider's supported range.

provider.description: Optional provider key (e.g. 'brave', 'exa', 'kagi', 'youcom' — aliases 'you', 'you.com' also accepted). Omit for the server's default provider.

tools.name: web_search
